_doc: W1-DATA-06 originally checked only uuid tenant_id columns, so tables whose
tenant_id is text never entered the gate and reported clean while carrying no
Every table listed here has RLS ENABLED and FORCED, so tenant isolation is
enforced by the database. What they lack is referential integrity: a row can
reference a tenant id that does not exist or has been deleted.
This file records that debt so it is visible and tracked instead of silent.
The gate now fails for any text tenant_id table that is NOT listed here, so no
new occurrences can be added without an explicit decision.
To clear an entry: migrate tenant_id to uuid, add FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id)
REFERENCES tenants(id), VALIDATE it, then delete the line. Run
